name: @arp/sponsor
description: ARP's sponsoring service, testnet 13579 only: a deposit paid by ARP and owned by the agent when the use is proven, the one-time gas for the agent's approve, and the publication of signed delegations. Holds ARP's treasury key; calls the MultiVault and nothing else (ADR 0092, 0094).

scripts.start: bun run --cwd ../../packages/protocol build && bun run src/main.ts
